count(kube_pod_owner)
count(kube_replicaset_owner)
max by (namespace,workload_kind,workload,container,reason) (max_over_time((max by (namespace,workload_kind,workload,container,pod,reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_timestamp{namespace=~"^(infra|payments)$",container!=""} * on (namespace,pod,container) group_left(reason) max by (namespace,pod,container,reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"^(infra|payments)$",container!=""}) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(workload_kind,workload) (label_replace((label_replace(max by (namespace,pod,owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{namespace="payments",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}), "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)") * on (namespace,replicaset) group_left(workload) (label_replace(max by (namespace,replicaset,owner_name) (kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="payments",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_name=~"^(api)$",owner_is_controller="true"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))), "workload_kind", "Deployment", "workload", ".*") or label_replace((label_replace(max by (namespace,pod,owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{namespace="payments",owner_kind="StatefulSet",owner_name=~"^(db)$",owner_is_controller="true"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")), "workload_kind", "StatefulSet", "workload", ".*") or label_replace((label_replace(max by (namespace,pod,owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{namespace="infra",owner_kind="DaemonSet",owner_name=~"^(agent)$",owner_is_controller="true"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")), "workload_kind", "DaemonSet", "workload", ".*"))))[7d:5m])) > (time() - 604800)
sum by (namespace,workload_kind,workload,container) (increase((max by (namespace,workload_kind,workload,container,pod) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"^(infra|payments)$",container!=""} * on (namespace,pod) group_left(workload_kind,workload) (label_replace((label_replace(max by (namespace,pod,owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{namespace="payments",owner_kind="ReplicaSet",owner_is_controller="true"}), "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)") * on (namespace,replicaset) group_left(workload) (label_replace(max by (namespace,replicaset,owner_name) (kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="payments",owner_kind="Deployment",owner_name=~"^(api)$",owner_is_controller="true"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))), "workload_kind", "Deployment", "workload", ".*") or label_replace((label_replace(max by (namespace,pod,owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{namespace="payments",owner_kind="StatefulSet",owner_name=~"^(db)$",owner_is_controller="true"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")), "workload_kind", "StatefulSet", "workload", ".*") or label_replace((label_replace(max by (namespace,pod,owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{namespace="infra",owner_kind="DaemonSet",owner_name=~"^(agent)$",owner_is_controller="true"}), "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")), "workload_kind", "DaemonSet", "workload", ".*"))))[7d:5m]))
